paper.title: Integrated Optimization of Offshore Wind Farm Layout Design and Turbine Opportunistic Condition-Based Maintenance

source_search.target_result: Exact-title, DOI, author, repository and GitHub code searches found no target implementation, data archive, random states or raw results.

paper_designated_predecessor.title: Two-stage simulation optimization for optimal development of offshore wind farm under wind uncertainty
paper_designated_predecessor.relationship: same two-stage GA and pattern-search layout lineage with distinct 132-candidate 7 km by 3 km problem

paper_native_protocol.maintenance_stage_2: k-means plus Monte Carlo periodic opportunistic condition-based maintenance

missing_information: target source, exact 342 coordinates and field polygon, random states, raw layouts, traces and repeat count
2014 ten-minute wind observations and price, capacity-revenue, random-outage and preventive-maintenance traces
GA population, selection, crossover and mutation; target pattern-search options and k-means initialization
component degradation distributions, failure/on-condition/opportunistic thresholds and Monte Carlo replication count
inspection cost, downtime rate, maintenance weather-delay rule and numeric cluster assignment
conflicts_and_completions: Sections 3.1 and 5.1 and Figure 1 state 342 candidate locations while Section 3.5 prints M=232; use 342 decision bits and treat 232 as the reported optimized turbine count.
Section 3.1 gives 100 m adjacent candidate spacing while Section 5.1 says 400 m; use 100 m because it is consistent with the stated 3 km by 1.5 km site, 342 candidates and 232 selected turbines.
Section 5.2 says four clusters while the Figure-8 caption says two; execute four clusters as primary and retain an explicit two-cluster conflict profile.
Figure 7 calls the continuous result Stage 2, but Sections 3.5 and 5.1 and Table 3 call it Part 2 of Stage 1; use the latter stage identity.
Use a deterministic irregular 342-point subset of the stated 100 m lattice; it is a declared mask, not the unavailable author coordinates.
Use 100 binary-GA individuals, uniform crossover, tournament selection, one-over-342 bit mutation and two elites; 50 generations are inherited from the cited public predecessor.

Use 200 deterministic rotating five-turbine coordinate-poll iterations with adaptive 1 to 50 m mesh; the iteration count is inherited from the predecessor and the poll realization is a declared completion.

Use deterministic k-means; 1000 Monte Carlo replications; thresholds 0.65, 0.85 and 1.0; lognormal random degradation rates with mean lives 18, 14, 11 and 13 years; 25000 USD farm inspection and 20000 USD per downtime day.
Complete the qualitative weather restriction with a declared Weibull inspection-day wind draw and a one-to-five-day delay above 15 m/s.
Use 60 USD per MWh, 45000 USD capacity revenue per turbine-year and 160000 USD annualized unit capital scale to instantiate missing economics; no completion is calibrated to Tables 3-5.
Use 25 platform seeds because the paper gives no independent repeat count.

strategy: one persistent all-core executor per integrated optimization
parallel complete binary-GA candidate evaluation with immutable population reads and fixed-index result writes
parallel independent continuous pattern-poll candidates with deterministic best-move commit
parallel fixed-index Monte Carlo maintenance replications and ordered statistical reduction
precomputed counter-keyed wind scenarios and trigonometry
counter-keyed schedule-independent evolutionary and degradation events
hpc.dominant_complexity: GA and pattern-poll complete layouts times 40 wind scenarios times selected-turbine-count squared, plus intervals times replications times turbines times four components times inspections
hpc.required_invariant: one-worker and all-worker layouts, clusters, all twelve roles, physical-work counts and scientific hash identity

claim_boundary: Source-backed flexible academic reconstruction of the target coupled problem, target method sequence and all twelve native paper roles; not author source, unavailable New Jersey, wind or degradation arrays, or numerical replay.
